ideas.title: Investigating the Minneapolis Shooting
ideas.description: A deeper investigation into the fatal shooting of Alex Pretti by federal agents in Minneapolis, including an examination of the circumstances surrounding the incident and the response of law enforcement agencies.
questions: What were the circumstances surrounding the shooting?
How did law enforcement agencies respond to the incident?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover important truths about the use of force by law enforcement agencies and the response of government officials to incidents of police brutality. By following the money and examining the financial interests of key players, we may be able to uncover a larger pattern of corruption or misconduct.
